_about: Public-domain John William Colenso (1814-1883), first Bishop of Natal, for the Word Hoard: Ten Weeks in Natal (1855), The Pentateuch and Book of Joshua Critically Examined (parts 1-5, 1862-1865), the book that brought his trial for heresy, St. Paul's Epistle to the Romans newly translated and explained (1863) and his Natal Sermons (1866). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 80 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

colenso-ten-weeks-natal: Ten weeks in Natal. A journal of a first tour of visitation among the colonists and Zulu Kafirs of Natal (Cambridge [Eng.] : Macmillan & co., 1855)
